name: Checkbox
purpose: Render a finished independent checked, unchecked, or mixed selection with Atom interaction and form behavior.
useWhen: A user independently turns an option on or off, or an aggregate parent represents mixed child selection.

avoidWhen.condition: Exactly one option must be selected from a set.

composition: Compose Checkbox.Root with Checkbox.Indicator and a visible associated label, usually inside Field or Fieldset.

rules.statement: Give every checkbox a visible associated label unless context is genuinely redundant and an accessible name remains.
Load styles.css or core.css plus checkbox.css and any Field/Fieldset styles used.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Checkbox for a one-of-many choice.
commonMistakes.correction: Use RadioGroup for mutually exclusive options.

validation: Toggle with Space, pointer, and touch.
Inspect checked/mixed and disabled states, label hit target, submitted value, focus, and contrast.
